generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: Last five years achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. One time of Indent amount.

Satisfactoriy completed at least 50% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 50% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).For Reserved Tenders Satisfactoriy completed at least 25% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 25% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).
Each Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability of owning the following Key and critical equipment for this work.GPS and other Survey instruments And Soil excavator such as Hitachi/Jcb
Line of credit including E-tender Indent No & addressed to undersigned not less then 30% of the Tender amount received from any Nationalized Bank
Contractor should be registered as Forest Contractor in Karnataka Forest Department for the year 2026-27
Income tax returned filed documents for the last three financial year to be enclosed.
A copy of GST no registered under GST act.
Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.
For address proof any only copy of Adhar,PAN Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours including EPF & ESI details to be uploaded) along with copy of Registration in Labour Department, EPF & ESI Registration Certificate
Caste Certificate Compulsory (for reserved category tenders)
Submission of Bid capacity (5 years Turnover) Amount of works contracted by contractors in all departments in the year 2026-27 (indent-wise) and turnover for the last five years

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of Mansoon Bamboo Plantation at Chigule Sy No. 24 in Kanakumbi Range

itemList.description: Survey   and   Demarcation   of   Planting   Areas   :   Survey   and demarcation  of  plantation  boundary  lines  after  clearing  the rank growth to a width of 2 m. in the areas width:-Thick under growth.

Aligning in the planting area along to the contours and marking for pit (without
staking)

Excavation of pits with vertically cut edges to make an uniform cube
and heaping the excavated soil (1/3rd top soil on the upper side and 2/3rd on
the lower side) Ordinary soil 0.60x0.60x0.60= 0.216 cum/pit (400 pits/Ha.)
Cost of 4"x6" seedlings for transplanting into 8"x12" PB's
Purchase of HDPE woven sack bags including 18%GST (Rate approved by CCF, Belagavi)
Procurement of 0.9225 cum. Farm Yard Manure / Compost, 0.9225 cum. of Sand and 1.845 cum of Redearth. (4.20 cmtr. required for 8"x12" minus 0.51 cmtr. of transplanted 4"x6" bag).
Mixing of ingredients, filling the polythene bags and duly arranging in orws after scraping the earth.
Transplanting of 4" x 6" size bagged seedlings into 8" x 12" size bags.
Watering to the Polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01-12-2026 to 31-03-2027 (121 (days)
Weeding in the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials / compounds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel / maintainence / electricity bill of pumpset and other unforeseen items and charges

Preparation of fence posts, duly fashioned conical at the top, debarked and tar coated complete; 2 m length and 38 cm Girth (Wooden post material should be obtained from dead timber material already available in forest areas or by singling out of forked poles of appropriate size and not by cutting live tree).
Transport of fence posts up to 10 km distance including loading and unloading charges using hired vehicle.
Fixing the fence posts after digging pits of 30 cm x 30 cm x 40 cm depth and consolidation, ensuring firm fixture.
Purchase of Barbed wire (Including GST 18%) 12 x 14 Guage good quality of G.I. Barbed wire with zinc coating thickness of minimum 90 GSM
Cost of "U" nails
Unrollig and fixing babed wire with "U" nails in four rows, ensuring proper fixture.

Refilling of pits, cutting of edge of the pit on the lower
side and refilling 75% or 100% of the pit as the case may
be with the excavated soil, duly breaking the clods &
arranging the remaining soil on the lower slope. 0.60cum =
86.40 cum x 0.75 = 64.80 cum

Loading and unloading of Polythene / HDPE Bagged
Seedlings: Loading of polythene / HDPE bagged seedlings
into vehicle at the nursery site and unloading at the site
nearest to the planting site - Seedlings raised in 8" x
12" size bags.

Transportation: Transportation of polythene / HDPE bagged seedlings in vehicle from nursery site to planting  site. Seedlings raised in 8”x12” size bags. Distance from 21 to 30 km. (Considering the actual distance)

Conveyance: Conveyance of polythene / HDPE bagged
seedlings as head loads from the dumping site to planting
location near each trench / pits (distance up to 3 Km.)
8”x12” size bagged seedlings.

Watering polythene / HDPE bagged seedlings at planting
site by dipping in water (including carrying of water)
only in dry conditions of weather. 8”x12” size bagged
seedlings

Planting of polythene / HDPE bags seedlings after tearing
with blade and removing the polythene / HDPE bags in pits
including scooping the soil to required depth and pressing
the soil gently around the seedlings after planting.
Purchase of NPK / DAP (25+25 =50 gms per plant) 2 times

Application of chemical fertilizer around the plants about
15 cm. away in a furrow duly covering with soil (excludingthe cost of fertilizer) in two equal split doses.

First weeding around the plants (pits) to a radius of 60
cm.

Scraping of grass and other weed growth around the plants
to a radius of 60 cm (Scraping item is allowed only in
grass infested areas.)

Hoeing & soil working with pickaxe around the plant to a
depth of 15cm. & to radius of 60 cm. so as to loosen the
soil around the plants.

Protection of plantation as per the standard norms (for 25
ha. as a unit during the year and pro-rata for different
extent for the actual period) from: 01-07-2026 to
31-03-2027= 274 days

Fire Protection work in plantations: New Fire Lines:
Cutting of all existing weed growth to a width of 3 m.
heaping, burning and re-burning in younger plantations.
Watering to the Polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01-04-2026 to 29-06-2026= 90 days
Weeding in the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials / compounds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel / maintainence / electricity bill of pumpset and other unforeseen items and charges
